title: Stiffelio
facts: This became the Teatro Grande (now the Teatro Comunale Giuseppe Verdi) in  Trieste and, in spite of difficulties with the censors which resulted in cuts and changes, the opera  – Verdi's 16th – was first performed on 16 November 1850.
Stiffelio is an opera in three acts by Giuseppe Verdi, from an Italian libretto by Francesco Maria Piave.
